description: First decisive V5 error in AI Chessathon rated round 48. Diagnostic regression only; the reference move comes from independent Stockfish 18 analysis at 100,000 nodes.

positions.label: Keresight, Black move 49
positions.diagnosis: V5 spent only about 1.24 seconds despite having 41.5 seconds left, completed depth 10, and played Kg8 in an equal ending. The move loses by force; Kh7 holds. The same search reaches depth 12 and selects Kh7 when given V7's 3.35-second budget.
